title: Sand Box Sand Castles
lyrics:
introspective G4 swagger builder anthem, sifting sand textures with granular shakers and soft flowing pads, evolving sneaky phonk undertones into powerful sand-castle building drops, low VDS deployment rumble bass, thoughtful narrative male vocals with ad-libs and confident swagger, positive sovereign creation energy, patient meticulous vibe mixed with triumphant foundation moments, 336 Hz deep resonant foundation

[Intro - Sift]
Sifting sand in their sandboxes...
Making sand castles whilst the VDS deploys...
No grain denied...
Each grain of sand identified...

[Verse 1]
I'm in the sandbox sifting, grain by grain by grain
Every scattered file and domain calling out its name
From old drives and forgotten piles, the chaos of before
Now single source of truth, I'm building something more

[Pre-Chorus]
Patient hands, no rush, just the steady sift
Identifying every piece so the castle can lift

[Chorus]
Sifting sand in their sandboxes, making sand castles rise
Whilst the VDS deploys in the background, under open skies
No grain denied, each grain of sand identified
Building real from the chaos with that G4 pride

[Verse 2]
Sand castles in the making, towers made of code
Every brick accounted for, every detail showed
Automation running deep while I work the sand by hand
Sovereign in the process, this is how I stand

[Bridge - Deployment Hum]
VDS hums in the background, deployment in the flow
I'm sifting in the foreground, letting everything grow
No grain left behind, no piece left unidentified
The castle keeps on rising because the foundation's fortified

[Final Chorus - G4 Swagger]
Sifting sand in their sandboxes... (G4 in the sift)
Making sand castles... (VDS deploys the lift)
No grain denied... each grain identified...
My sand castle stands because I sifted right...

[Outro - Fade]
Sifting sand... in their sandboxes...
Making sand castles... whilst the VDS deploys...
No grain denied...
Each grain of sand... identified...
